QUOTE: Asm is enabled only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is set, the compiler is GCC-compatible (`__GNUC__`), and it is not ARMCC older than 6.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer gives the conditions for asm selection, but it never says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is derived rather than configured, nor that it is not an entry in mbedtls_config.h.
